landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Rent a vehicle in just 4 simple steps — fast, transparent, and hassle-free.
landing.howItWorksStep1Desc: Browse our premium fleet catalog and pick the vehicle that suits your needs.
landing.howItWorksStep2Desc: Select your pickup and return dates, then confirm your booking instantly.
landing.howItWorksStep3Desc: Pay securely via transfer, card, or cash with transparent rates — no hidden fees.
landing.howItWorksStep4Desc: Pick up your vehicle and hit the road with 24/7 support on every journey.
landing.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about renting with Smart Rental.
landing.faqQuestion1: What documents do I need to rent a vehicle?
landing.faqAnswer1: You need a valid SIM (driver's license), a government-issued ID (KTP/Passport), and a refundable deposit that varies by vehicle category.
landing.faqQuestion2: Is there a minimum rental duration?
landing.faqAnswer2: The minimum rental period is 1 day (24 hours). For weekly and monthly rentals, we offer special discounted rates.
landing.faqQuestion3: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
landing.faqAnswer3: Yes, you can cancel or modify your booking up to 24 hours before pickup at no charge. Late cancellations may incur a 50% fee.
landing.faqQuestion4: What happens if the vehicle breaks down?
landing.faqAnswer4: Our 24/7 roadside assistance team will be dispatched immediately. A replacement vehicle will be arranged at no extra cost.
landing.faqQuestion5: Do you offer delivery and pickup service?
landing.faqAnswer5: Yes, we offer free delivery and pickup within the city center. Additional areas may incur a small transportation fee.
